title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
description: Return the number of nodes on the longest path from the root to a leaf.
note: An empty tree has depth zero. A leaf has depth one.
notes: The early return after root is none narrows root to TreeNode in the remaining body. Its optional children can be passed directly to maxDepth.
Compute the depth of each subtree, take the larger result with max, and add one for the current node. The proposed max built-in needs no imports.
LeetCode supplies TreeNode. The record declaration shows how the same type would be defined in a standalone Birdie program.
The traversal takes O(n) time and O(h) recursion space, where h is the tree height. It does not modify the tree.
